title: 25:4 thou hast been a strength to the poor. The Hebrew word for strength may be translated as "stronghold" (23:4), aptly describing how "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble" (Ps. 46:1). The poor and needy described here are not simply financially bereft; they include the poor in spirit and the meek who are willing to submit to God's will and who will inherit the earth and the kingdom of heaven (3 Ne. 12:5; D&C 56:18-19). The Lord's strength makes these poor and needy into "strong people," standing in contrast to the strength of the rich and their "strong city" (Prov. 10:15), which will be brought down by the Lord (25:5).
author: Tina M. Peterson
